name: Microsoft Viva Insights
description: Microsoft Viva Insights provides privacy-protected personal, manager, leader, organizational, and analyst insights about work patterns, collaboration, productivity, wellbeing, and Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption.
agentUseSummary: Microsoft documents Viva activity statistics only through a Microsoft Graph beta API that is explicitly unsupported for production applications. Advanced analysis results are available through the Viva Insights web experience and Microsoft-managed Power BI, Excel, and Fabric connectors, so Relay mounts no personal, team, organization, query, export, settings, or mutation tools until Microsoft publishes a supported production API contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft Graph exposes Viva activity statistics and analytics settings only under /beta and states that beta APIs are unsupported for production applications. Microsoft's stable item-insights APIs explicitly do not address Viva Insights, and advanced analysis data is documented through the Viva web app and Microsoft-managed Power BI, Excel, and Fabric connectors rather than a supported public runtime API.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Microsoft Viva Insights unavailable until Microsoft publishes a supported production REST API with a reviewable least-privilege permission model for a bounded, privacy-preserving personal or aggregate read surface.

evidence.supports: Microsoft describes Viva Insights as privacy-protected personal, manager, leader, organizational, and advanced analyst experiences spanning collaboration, wellbeing, productivity, and Copilot analytics.
Microsoft documents delegated Analytics.Read access to personal Viva activity statistics only in Microsoft Graph beta and explicitly states that beta APIs are unsupported for production applications.
Microsoft explicitly distinguishes stable Microsoft Graph item-insights privacy APIs from Viva Insights, MyAnalytics, the Outlook Insights add-in, and related Viva experiences.

Microsoft documents advanced query results through the role-gated Viva web experience and Microsoft-managed CSV, Excel, and Power BI connection flows, including de-identified and potentially row-level organizational data.
